workflows.name: schema_result_view
workflows.description: 结构化结果详情展示验收（脱敏/截断/空态）

workflows.name: coder
workflows.description: 按任务修改代码、运行必要验证并如实报告结果

workflows.name: reviewer
workflows.description: 独立审查当前工作区改动，输出带证据的可核查 findings

workflows.name: judge
workflows.description: 依据任务、变更事实与评审证据裁决通过、继续修复或升级用户决策

workflows.name: fixer
workflows.description: 按已确认的 findings 在根因处修复并重新验证

workflows.name: quality_loop
workflows.description: coder -> reviewer -> judge 的默认质量闭环，continue 时按上限修复后复审复裁
